checks: Launch identity exists on disk before polling; HTTP503 HTML, HTTP200 HTML and malformed JSON preserve safe metadata and confirm normal stop.
A failed stop preserves both test and cleanup errors without falsely claiming stopped.
An interrupted second launch has its own result and leaves the first successful result unchanged.
An ambiguous launch creation request is recorded separately, never repeated, and does not stop a prior completed launch.
An ambiguous stop response is reconciled with GET, without a second mutation.
Two successful launches retain the established evidence format.

scope: Native test harness only. Real CLI subprocesses use a loopback HTTP server; no provider quota, live database writes or production fault injection. Production server, runner, build and launch behavior are unchanged. Initial account/bootstrap failures and process or filesystem crashes are outside this regression scope.
